call_points.text: As RE implementing agency SJVN has awarded about 16 GW but signed PSAs for only about 6 GW.
Management says some of the unsigned PPAs may not be signed because DISCOM configurations and tariffs have moved.
Buxar Unit 1 earned ₹522 Cr revenue against ₹644 Cr expenses in its first three months, a post-tax loss of about ₹93 Cr.
SGEL FY26 revenue was ₹510 Cr against ₹232 Cr, with a loss of ₹258 Cr versus ₹151 Cr, on lower CUF and Bikaner ramping up.
FY26 generation from all stations was 13,302 million units, up 25% from 10,646 million units in FY25.
Board recommended a final dividend of ₹0.35 a share, taking FY26 total to ₹1.50 a share.

guidance.statement: Capacity addition of about 2,284 MW planned in FY27
Capacity addition of about 650 MW planned in FY28, mainly solar
Capex plan of about ₹9,400 Cr for FY27, ₹7,800 Cr for FY28 and ₹7,500 Cr for FY29
Arun-III Nepal all four units targeted for commissioning by December 2028
25,000 MW by 2030 and 50,000 MW by 2040 targets under review; new business plan to follow

operating_notes.text: Buxar Unit 1 ran at about 60% PLF and 70% plant availability in FY26; management says profit starts above 70% PLF.
Bikaner 1,000 MW solar faces about 120 MW curtailment until the SVR is commissioned in October 2026; Khawada may see about 300 MW curtailed.
SJVN has awarded about 16 GW as RE implementing agency, signed PSAs for about 6 GW, and awarded 2,000 MWh of BESS projects.

timeline.summary: On 15 May 2026 SJVN's Q4FY26 call reported FY26 revenue up 22% to ₹3,545 Cr on a ₹679 Cr tariff truing-up and PAT up 4% to ₹1,008 Cr, with the 25,000 MW 2030 target under review.

watchlist.response: Management said it is very difficult to say and that some PPAs may not be signed because DISCOM configurations and tariffs have moved.

watchlist.response: Management said the targets are under review and a new business plan will be shared soon, without giving a revised number.
